import json, os, re, subprocess, sys
sys.path.insert(0, "scripts")
from observe_output import no_turn, observe
import execution_receipt, ledger
for flag in ("--timeout", "--stall-seconds", "--idle-seconds"):
    for bad in ("nan", "inf", "-inf"):
        p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "scripts/execution_runner.py", "--spec", "s", "--spec-sha256", "h", "--log", "l", f"{flag}={bad}"], capture_output=True, text=True)
        assert p.returncode == 2 and "ERROR: timeout, stall and idle seconds must be finite numbers" in p.stderr, (flag, bad, p.returncode, p.stderr)
for flag, msg in (("--timeout", "ERROR: timeout cannot be negative"), ("--stall-seconds", "ERROR: stall and idle seconds cannot be negative"), ("--idle-seconds", "ERROR: stall and idle seconds cannot be negative")):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "scripts/execution_runner.py", "--spec", "s", "--spec-sha256", "h", "--log", "l", flag, "-1"], capture_output=True, text=True)
    assert p.returncode == 2 and msg in p.stderr, (flag, p.returncode, p.stderr)
for script, prefix in (("scripts/spawn-worker.sh", "SPAWN_WORKER"), ("scripts/spawn-brain.sh", "SPAWN_BRAIN")):
    for suffix in ("TIMEOUT_SECS", "STALL_SECS", "IDLE_SECS"):
        name = prefix + "_" + suffix
        for bad in ("-1", "nan", "inf", "abc", "1.", ".5"):
            env = dict(os.environ, **{name: bad})
            p = subprocess.run(["bash", script], env=env, capture_output=True, text=True)
            assert p.returncode == 2 and ("ERROR: " + name + " must be a non-negative number") in p.stderr, (name, bad, p.returncode, p.stderr)
raw = open("tests/fixtures/observe/claude-zero-turns.json", "rb").read()
doc = json.loads(raw)
assert doc["num_turns"] == 0 and doc["usage"]["input_tokens"] == 2 and doc["usage"]["output_tokens"] == 33, doc["usage"]
assert no_turn("claude", raw) is True
assert observe("claude", raw)["usage"]["input"] == {"value": 2, "source": "observed"}
assert observe("claude", raw)["usage"]["output"] == {"value": 33, "source": "observed"}
r = lambda d: (json.dumps(d) + "\n").encode()
assert no_turn("claude", r({"type": "result", "num_turns": 1, "usage": {"input_tokens": 0, "output_tokens": 0}})) is True
assert no_turn("claude", r({"type": "result", "num_turns": 1, "usage": {"input_tokens": 0, "output_tokens": 5}})) is False
assert no_turn("claude", r({"type": "result", "num_turns": 1, "usage": {"input_tokens": 5, "output_tokens": 0}})) is False
assert no_turn("claude", r({"type": "result", "num_turns": False, "usage": {"input_tokens": 5, "output_tokens": 5}})) is False
assert no_turn("codex", r({"type": "turn.completed", "usage": {"input_tokens": 0, "output_tokens": 0}})) is True
assert no_turn("codex", r({"type": "turn.completed", "usage": {"input_tokens": 0, "output_tokens": 5}})) is False
assert no_turn("codex", r({"type": "turn.completed", "usage": {"input_tokens": 5, "output_tokens": 0}})) is False
assert no_turn("cursor", r({"type": "result", "usage": {"inputTokens": 0, "outputTokens": 5}})) is False
assert no_turn("cursor", r({"type": "result", "usage": {"inputTokens": 5, "outputTokens": 0}})) is False
rs = json.load(open("schemas/execution-receipt.schema.json"))["$defs"]["receiptBody"]["properties"]["outcome"]["enum"]
ls = json.load(open("schemas/ledger-row.schema.json"))["properties"]["outcome"]["enum"]
runner_outcomes = set(re.findall(r'"(completed|failed|timed_out|stalled|interrupted|launch_failed)"', open("scripts/execution_runner.py").read()))
assert tuple(rs) == tuple(ledger.OUTCOMES) == tuple(ls) and set(rs) == execution_receipt.OUTCOMES == runner_outcomes
print("ok")
